App._comment: BaseUrl: the studio (SPA) origin, for links in emails and the run log. ApiBaseUrl: this API's public origin — the address Orbit and Projects deliver events to, and webhook trigger URLs start with. Both must be https in production.

Connectors._comment: The apps Flow connects to. ApiUrl: each app's API; AppUrl: its app, for links. SharedKey (optional, 32+ characters): signs the two-minute connect assertion; the same value must be set on the app's API as FlowIntegration:SharedKey. When empty the suite's shared Jwt:Key signs it. SecretKey (optional): base64 of 32 random bytes that seals connection tokens and webhook secrets; when empty a key derived from Jwt:Key is used.
Connectors._oauth: Outside apps, each hidden until its settings exist (set them in App Service config, never here). Every app registration lists one redirect URL: {App:ApiBaseUrl}/api/oauth/{slack|microsoft|google}/callback. Slack also needs SigningSecret and the Events API request URL {App:ApiBaseUrl}/api/oauth/slack/events. Microsoft:Tenant defaults to common. PollSeconds: how often Outlook, Gmail and Sheets triggers poll (60 to 3600, default 120).

Flow._comment: Limits. MonthlyRuns: runs per workspace per calendar month (a workspace's own MonthlyRunQuota wins). RunsPerMinute: per workspace. FlowRunsPerMinute: one flow's runs in a minute before it is paused (the loop breaker). StepTimeoutSeconds: one step's limit. MaxSteps: steps in a flow. EmailsPerDay: Send email steps per workspace per day.

Billing._comment: Flow's plans, per workspace. Runs: a calendar month (UTC). ActiveFlows: flows switched on at once (0: no limit). Premium: premium apps and steps can be switched on. AiCredits: AI builder credits a month. TrialDays: Pro for a new workspace, from when billing goes live (Stripe:SecretKey set). PremiumApps / PremiumSteps: comma lists of what is premium (a catalog entry's own Premium flag counts too). The amounts people pay are Stripe prices (Stripe:Prices), not here.

Stripe._comment: Set these in App Service config, never here. SecretKey: billing is off ("Not set up yet") until it is set. WebhookSecret: the signing secret of the endpoint {App:ApiBaseUrl}/api/billing/webhook. Prices: a Stripe price id per key, each with GBP, EUR, AUD and CAD currency options.

Graph._comment: App-only Microsoft Graph mail sender — the default for the Send email step (the same app registration Orbit uses). Set these in App Service config, not here.

Smtp._comment: Fallback sender when Graph isn't configured. Set these in App Service config, not here.
